turns.query: For JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. (FDIC certificate 628) at 2025-06-30, use FDIC BankFind quarterly financials to report total and domestic deposits and derive the foreign-office residual between them. Independently aggregate all reported 2025 Summary of Deposits branch rows for that certificate, reconcile their branch deposits to the BankFind domestic balance, and report the branch-row and represented state-level-jurisdiction counts. Aggregate branch deposits by branch-state USPS abbreviation, breaking an exact leadership tie alphabetically; report the leading jurisdiction, its branch-row count and share of branch rows, its branch deposits and share of domestic deposits, and the state-level deposit HHI on the 0-to-10,000 scale. Explain what the reconciliation and concentration measures do and do not represent.
